Case reference: 2014004726.CaseDesc: On July 21, 1992, Brenda Wilson was last seen at her residence in Moncton, New Brunswick. She lived alone and all of her personal belongings were left behind. At the time of her disappearance, Brenda was despondent.

Case reference: 2014006264.CaseDesc: William (Bill) Kwiatek was last seen in Canmore, Alberta, in July 1988. He was leaving a bar and had planned to hitchhike back to Calgary, but never made it there. In 2013, William was reported missing, but very few details are known about when he was last seen.

Amputation: Left Ring Finger, Partial missing finger

Case reference: 2023058186.CaseDesc: Ywanna (Jean) Backman was last seen by a friend on October 15, 2023. On the next day, firewood was delivered to her remote rural residence near Piney, Manitoba. Her vehicle was there, but she was not. Personal items were left in the residence, along with her dentures, and she appears to have been preparing breakfast, as bread was in the toaster, and eggs were on the countertop.  Ywanna lives alone with no cell phone or computer.

Hair: Blonde, Dyed, Shoulder, Gray dyed blonde

Case reference: 2012020095.CaseDesc: On February 21, 2006, between 8:00 and 8:30 am Draper Jim was dropped off on the road by the Health Center on the Saulteaux First Nation (North of Cochin, Saskatchewan). Draper was attempting to return home to the Witchekan First Nation and has not been seen since.

Scar: Lower Lip, Left side of lower lip
Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Ying Yang Symbol

Case reference: 2008005698.CaseDesc: On February 16th, 1994, Calvin Simms was last seen in the area of Church Street in St. Catharines, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance, Calvin was experiencing a period of despondency.

Case reference: 2014004543.CaseDesc: Marguerite Cardwell was last seen in Calgary, Alberta on September 10, 1973, when she informed a friend of her intention to travel to either Edmonton Alberta or Vancouver, British Columbia. Marguerite's vehicle was subsequently discovered in the vicinity of Canmore, Alberta, on September 16, 1973. It was noted that her purse and other personal belongings were found inside the vehicle.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Ankle, 2 inch screw in ankle

Case reference: 2015037946.CaseDesc: On July 14, 2015, Raymond Flett was seen for the last time in Thompson, Manitoba. Raymond is known to frequent the areas of Split Lake and Thompson.
